name: Ülker Napoliten 33 G
truth: Sugar, whole milk powder, cocoa butter, cocoa mass, skimmed milk powder, emulsifier (soy lecithin), flavouring. Cocoa solids: 32% minimum. May contain traces of nuts, peanuts, egg products and gluten.
